recentItems.title: How to Play GTA 6 in First-Person (It's a Glitch!)
recentItems.description:
GTA 6 doesn't feature a proper first-person camera... Yet! But that hasn't stopped players from discovering a potential camera glitch in Grand Theft Auto 6, allowing anyone to enter into 1st person mode! This sneaky bug is easy to reproduce and is still in the launch version of GTA VI! Don't worry, this secret first-person mode works on both the PS5 and Xbox versions of Grand Theft Auto VI.
Here are the steps:
1) Enter GTA 6’s Settings menu.
2) Use the bumpers to move across to the ‘CONTROLLER’ tab.
3) Scroll down to ‘Touch Pad Button’ or ‘View Button’.
4) Change it from ‘Map’ to ‘Camera’.
5) Enter a car.
6) Bring up your phone using the d-pad.
7) Press either the Circle or B button to put your phone away while spamming the 'Camera' button. Repeat these steps until first-person mode is locked in!

recentItems.title: Battleground Cleaner Simulator: Official Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description:
When army-sized battles rage in stuff like Game of Thrones, SOMEONE has to clean up the mess afterwards. That's the premise behind Battleground Cleaner Simulator, which tasks you with tidying up after chaotic medieval events like battlefields, taverns, and feasts that leave blood all over the castle, bodies with forks in their eyes, and so, so much more. Wishlist Battleground Cleaner Simulator on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527820/Battleground_Cleaner_Simulator/

recentItems.title: GTA 6: Xbox Series X Vs PlayStation 5 Pro Graphics Comparison
recentItems.description:
It’s been 13 long years since the last time we got a new GTA game, and now that we’ve had three console generations between both games, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. If you haven’t figured out what platform to play it on yet, or just want to see if there really is a big enough difference to pull the trigger on a PlayStation 5 pro or Xbox Series X, then you’ve come to the right place. 
We’re going to take a look at how the game runs and looks on both flagship consoles and let you decide which is the best way to visit Vice City. 
Regardless of what platform you play the game on, its remarkable that it runs this well and looks this good on 6 year old hardware
